messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick check-in for the pub staging: need ARM64 image, publisher tenant mapping, and final revenue-share blurb for marketplace listing. Can we lock these today?

ryan-partnerops: Hi — ARM64 image build in progress. We're producing a multi-arch manifest. Expect push to ghcr.io/redwood/marketplace:v2026-03-23-arm64 by 12:30 PT.

priya-aws: AWS notes: marketplace requires the AMI to have HVM virtualization and the license info filled. Also ask: will partner SI integrations require separate SKU bundles?

carlos-product: For SI integrations, we'll create a separate "SI Ready" SKU flag in the catalog. That keeps trials separate. Ryan, can packaging include an `si_metadata.json` with supported connectors?

ryan-partnerops: yes — we'll add si_metadata.json to the artifacts. Schema: ```{ "connectors": ["okta","sap","mulesoft"], "version": "1.0.0" }``` Will that work?

lucy-legal: Revenue share: partners requested 20% rev share on third-party managed offers. That diverges from our standard 15%. Need approvals from finance. Also legal needs to add a marketplace-specific addendum for SI liability carveouts.

maia-marketing: If revenue share changes, we need to update the partner co-marketing plan. Also need a hero image in 16:9 and a short 90-char blurb. Can we get placeholder text while legal finalizes?

jamie-azure: Azure publishing: publisher tenant GUID still missing. Anna, can you provide the tenant GUID and publisher display name so we can set offer permissions?

anna-partnerships: Tenant GUID: `d2f5a9b8-7c3e-4a6b-b112-9f8a1c2d3e44`. Publisher display name: "Redwood Inference (Partner)". Sending to Azure portal now.

priya-aws: On AMI tagging: please include `Marketplace:Redwood` tag + `Arch:arm64|x86_64`. This helps our automation.

ryan-partnerops: Got it. Tagging strategy: `Key=Marketplace,Value=redwood` and `Key=Arch,Value=arm64`. Pushing AMI to staging account `aws-marketplace-staging-acc`. AMI ID will be posted when ready.

infra-bot: artifact-upload: ghcr image redwood/marketplace:v2026-03-23-arm64 pushed at 2026-03-23T19:08:21Z :rocket:

carlos-product: Entitlement model: trial = 14 days, SI trial disabled by default. We need a mechanism to grant SI trials manually. I'll add a jira `PROD-8420` to track.

lucy-legal: Small ask: please remove any language saying "no refunds" for trials in the marketplace listing. Replace with "refunds handled per customer agreement". Also confirm whether EU-only trials are required for any customers.

anna-partnerships: We have one EU-only anchor customer but not necessary for the initial public listing. We can support EU-only trial filter; Ryan please include `allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"]` in the trial config.

ryan-partnerops: Done. trial_config.json will include that.

maia-marketing: Placeholder blurb: "Low-latency LLM inference for apps — secure, scalable, and cost-aware." Will update after legal review. Need hero by Thurs AM.

priya-aws: AMI ready: `ami-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h`. Published to staging. Please confirm ownership and license text.

anna-partnerships: Confirmed ownership. License text set to "Redwood Commercial". Lucy, does that sit ok for the marketplace addendum?

lucy-legal: That works for now. I'll circulate the marketplace addendum with the updated revenue share and SI carveouts — expect comments within 3 hours.

carlos-product: One more: SDK header for marketplace offers — will return `X-Offer-SKU` and `X-Offer-Entitlement`. Sam (cc'ed earlier) can you ensure SDK emits that on behalf of this listing?

maia-marketing: Also, who owns partner tweet copy? Anna? I'll need legal review time.

anna-partnerships: I'll draft the tweet and tag the partner comms. Send to legal for a short review. If everything greenlighted by EOD, we'll schedule the joint spotlight for next Tue. React with :white_check_mark: when your task is complete.

priya-aws: :white_check_mark: AMI published.

ryan-partnerops: :white_check_mark: ARM64 image & si_metadata pushed.

maia-marketing: :white_check_mark: Placeholder blurb in staging content.

lucy-legal: :white_check_mark: Addendum comments submitted.

anna-partnerships: Thanks team 1 — I'll assemble final artifact bundle and start uploads to the three marketplaces tomorrow morning at 08:30 PT. If anything pops up before then, DM me.
